name: Easy LQP (Low Quality Placeholder)
description: Provides a settings form to automatically generate image styles, and a Twig Filter to use the image styles in templates.
project_description: Easy LQP (Low Quality Placeholder) generates a low-quality, base64-encoded stand-in for an image that is sent inline in the initial HTML and then swapped for a full-size responsive derivative by client-side JavaScript once the image scrolls into view. A settings form auto-generates a family of scale, height and aspect-ratio image styles (named 'responsive_*') between a configurable minimum and maximum size; a field formatter ('Easy LQP Images') renders image fields using those styles plus the inline LQP; and a Twig 'image_url' filter lets themers build the same style URLs (with optional WebP variants) directly in media view-mode templates. It is a fork of functionality proposed for Easy Responsive Images and works best alongside Focal Point, ImageAPI Optimize, ImageAPI Optimize WebP and Imagecache External. Depends only on core Image.
